<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/get_project_variables/{guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The project's variables for the config field variable picker, with
where each is referenced, for the variable editor's warnings.

Usages are gathered from the hub and the caller's dev clone, so a
reference saved but not yet committed counts too. A secret's value is
left out entirely; the picker only needs its name.
